verdict.rationale: Alloy documents its own Sandbox mode, selected by base URL or header, that makes no vendor calls so integrations can be tested without charges. But the vendor states it is a per-request processing mode, not a separate environment, with no enforced data boundary: entities created in sandbox share the account's single data store with production. It behaves more like a dry-run of vendor calls than true sandbox isolation. missing for 10: an isolated sandbox environment with a production data boundary, separate sandbox data stores or credentials, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Sandbox makes no vendor calls, so you can test your integration without incurring additional charges
They are per-request processing modes only - Alloy does not enforce a data boundary.
